query:
SELECT 
  YEAR(CONVERT_TZ(saleDate, '+00:00', '-03:00')) as ano,
  SUM(finalAmount) as faturamento_total,
  COUNT(*) as total_vendas
FROM sales 
WHERE YEAR(CONVERT_TZ(saleDate, '+00:00', '-03:00')) = 2024
GROUP BY YEAR(CONVERT_TZ(saleDate, '+00:00', '-03:00'))
